There is nothing unusual about the training of Iharos, Chataway, Zatopek, Pirie, Norris Hewson and the rest - these men are quite normal individuals - everyone can adopt the same technique but the work involved must be built up over a number of years.

Previous to this, Charlie had won the Junior '5', in 1949; 1st in the L.C.C., and 2nd to Chataway in the South of Thames Junior in 1950. Those of the track tend to hide his excellent performances thereon.

This Meeting promises to live up to the very high standards of the past (remember four men inside 4mins in the 1957 mile?, remember Chataway v Kuts?, remember Herb Elliotts mile in 3mins 55.4secs?) and every Club member should make up his mind to be there and take his friends.

In addition he was reserve to Chataway for the Inter-Counties and ran for Surrey against the Olympic Possibles. He was now on the verge of breaking into top-class athletics, and could conceivably have set his eyes on the 1956 Olympics, but the effects of the war had not completely passed away and in…

Archie Bedford was our next runner and he returned a time of 14:26 which beat the old record of 14:30 and then Bill Lucas took over for the final leg and he did 14:11 which was only beaten by Chataway of Walton, who put up a new record time of 14:02 for this course of 2.94 miles.

From 1955 to the early 60's John's track career as a middle-distance runner fell only just so very, very short of full international status, but it should be noted that at that time he was vying with some of the great names of the past — Hewson, Chataway, Brasher and Pirie to name but a few.
Wes Santee, America's hot favourite for that honour, was entered together with Chataway and Nankeville plus Lawrenz (Germany) and Ericsson (Sweden).
